question: Rekha, from point A, walks 41 m towards the west. She takes a right turn and walks 84 m. She takes a right turn again and walks 92 m. Again, she takes a right turn and walks 84 m. She takes a right tum again and walks 19 m to reach point B. How far and in which direction is point B from point A? (All turns are 90 degree turns only)
solution:
Diagram is drawn as per the given information:

 
• Rekha, from point A, walks 41 m towards the west.
 
• She takes a right turn and walks 84 m.
 
• She takes a right turn again and walks 92 m.
 
• Again, she takes a right turn and walks 84 m.
 
• She takes a right tum again and walks 19 m to reach point B.

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a074ff457aa0ef66fffc41ca4c00db5fb270d203adbcf5de065504892330e120.png] 

Point B is **32 m away in the east direction** from Point A.

Hence, the correct answer is **Option (2).**
